title: The language of Niuafo'ou Island
text: Niuafo'ou shares with its neighbouring Polynesian languages Tongan and 'Uvean (Bataillon 1932) the same inventory of segmental phonemes which consists of five vowels and twelve consonants.

title: Global Volcanism Program | Niuafo'ou
text: Niuafo'ou ('Tin Can Island') is a low 8-km-wide island that forms the summit of a largely submerged basaltic shield volcano in the north central Lau Basin about 170 km W of the northern end of the Tofua volcanic arc.
